name: Stephane Castellani
headline: CMO · VP Marketing | 2x Founder | GTM & Revenue Architecture | Technical B2B SaaS | EMEA | Data · Analytics · AI
summary:
11x pipeline growth. $70M+ in qualified pipeline at 118% of quota. Category leadership recognized by Gartner, Forrester, and G2. None of it came from larger budgets or bigger teams. It came from building the right Go-to-Market architecture upstream, before buyers declared demand.

I have built and led demand generation, product marketing, and growth teams across Europe and North America, from VC-backed startups to publicly listed software companies, partnering with CEOs, CROs, CPOs, and investors on narrative, category strategy, and fundraising positioning. I operate across French, English, and German markets, making me a natural fit for US companies scaling in EMEA. I have also founded and exited two companies.

My approach is built on a clear conviction: revenue is shaped long before a buyer raises their hand. Buyers now move faster and more independently than ever before.

Buying behavior in B2B SaaS has changed more in the last two years than in the previous decade. A typical enterprise purchase now involves six to ten stakeholders, each researching independently, each arriving with pre-formed criteria and a shortlist already forming. They do not wait for a sales rep. They read community forums, scan G2 reviews, ask peers, and query LLMs directly.

Buyers now use ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude to research vendors and build shortlists before they ever visit a website. The research happens invisibly. It does not register in your CRM or your intent data platform. By the time demand is declared, the decision is largely made.

High-performing marketing teams win by building presence and preference before the pipeline exists.

What has changed is how I run the team. Agentic AI workflows are not an experiment: multi-step orchestration across market intelligence, content production, and competitive research, running in production today. A lean team operating these workflows outputs at a speed and scale that used to require three times the headcount.

positions.title: Senior Vice President Marketing
positions.description:
Joined as member of the executive team to restructure the full GTM function at a technically differentiated database startup.

Industrial enterprises and AI teams hit the same wall: data arrives faster than their infrastructure can make it useful, requiring pre-aggregation, schema redesign, and complex sync pipelines across multiple specialized systems. CrateDB removes the wall: one SQL engine, sub-second queries at any scale, across time-series, documents, text and vector embeddings, on data that just arrived.

As SVP Marketing, I built and own Go-to-Market across two core plays: operational analytics at machine scale for industrial and IoT environments, and AI applications on live multi-model data for teams building on ML models, RAG pipelines, LLM integration and agentic workflows.

Delivered 11x pipeline growth without budget increase, grew marketing contribution from 32% to 72% of new logo pipeline, and scaled inbound leads 8x with 3x product signups and 60% shorter conversion cycles.

Built a buyer's journey instrumentation layer to convert product engagement into pipeline before buyers surface to sales. Mapped behavioral signals across documentation reads, product trials, and community activity to identify and activate high-intent users early. Removed friction at every handoff point between first technical contact and sales conversation.

Deployed agentic AI workflows across the full marketing stack: multi-step orchestration for market intelligence, competitive research, content production, and pipeline analysis. A lean team now operates at the speed and scale that previously required three times the headcount.

positions.title: Global VP, Growth & Operations
positions.description:
Enterprises run on data flows they cannot afford to break: transactions with trading partners, integrations between internal systems, APIs connecting cloud applications. Axway makes those flows reliable, secured, governed, and scalable: API Management, iPaaS, EDI, and Managed File Transfer.

Owned new logo lead acquisition and qualification globally (€300M revenue, 45 countries), with a mandate to build a scalable, predictable growth engine across the company's fastest-growing categories.

Built and led a 33-person international revenue organization across BDR, SDR, Marketing Operations, and Digital, covering NA, EMEA, LATAM, and APAC. Redesigned lead qualification jointly with Sales VPs, the CRO, and product GMs, introducing shared definitions, SLAs, and a global KPI framework with regular operating cadences across Growth, Sales, and Finance.

Delivered 1,200 SQLs and $70M in qualified pipeline at 118% of quota, driving 54% of new logo pipeline. Raised MQL-to-opportunity conversion from 4% to 11%.

positions.title: Global VP, Product Marketing & Demand Generation
positions.description:
Owned global product marketing and demand generation across Axway's growth product lines: API Management, iPaaS, Mobile App Development, and MBaaS.

Rebuilt digital demand generation from the ground up, transitioning from agency-dependent campaigns to a fully in-house digital practice across content, SEO, paid media, and campaign orchestration. Developed structured competitive intelligence programs to sharpen positioning and enable field sales.

Cut cost per new logo opportunity by 60% in 18 months (from $23K to $9K) while tripling lead volume and reducing cost per lead by 70%. Secured leadership positions in the Gartner Magic Quadrant and Forrester Wave. Sourced multiple 7-figure deals through joint GTM campaigns with AWS and Azure.

positions.title: Global Senior Director, Product Marketing
positions.description:
Owned global product marketing across API Management, iPaaS, Mobile App Development, MBaaS, and Analytics, with a mandate to build the go-to-market motion for a new category of technical buyer.

Partnered with Sales to define the API Management sales play from scratch, creating positioning, messaging, and enablement for architects and software development leaders, a buyer profile the organization had not previously targeted. Shaped solution narratives and global launch programs to secure Gartner Magic Quadrant leadership. Drove the go-to-market strategy for the portfolio transition from perpetual licensing to subscription pricing.

Grew revenue across managed product lines from $20M to $55M. Improved win rates by 40% through competitive positioning and field enablement. Delivered 34% upsell growth from the licensing-to-subscription shift. Maintained Gartner Magic Quadrant leadership for three consecutive years.

positions.title: CEO & Founder

Took the product from concept to market, secured flagship clients, and built partnerships across e-commerce platforms, media agencies, and social advertising ecosystems. Ranked Top 100 Startups by Challenges magazine.

positions.title: Director of Product Marketing

Owned global product marketing for one of the two product lines, driving positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy for large enterprise accounts. Supported double-digit growth and a Gartner Magic Quadrant leadership position. Systar was subsequently acquired by Axway.
